blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing direction with sense: direction is the LINE (e.g., 45° from horizontal); sense is the ARROW direction (e.g., upward). A force can have the same direction but opposite sense.","Treating magnitude as signed: magnitude is always positive. The sign comes from sense, not from magnitude. Never write 'magnitude = −10 kN'.","Omitting sense on diagrams: an arrow without clear head/tail orientation leaves ambiguity about whether the force is tension or compression, push or pull."]} />
